data.name: Mental Manipulator
data.description: A hate-monger masters a broad repertoire of emotional corruption. At 1st level, he adds one spell to his spells known. When he would gain a new mesmerist trick, he can learn additional spells instead, adding two of spells of a level he can currently cast to his spells known. When he casts a spell he learns in this way, he increases the duration as if his caster level were 1 higher.
